QIMING / HOW

How it works

Connect the project entry, work, managed assets, knowledge, and verification in one recoverable directory.

01

Read the room

Inspect the directory, project instructions, existing material, and current goal. Your names and structure come first.

02

Create an entry

Establish a project-owned instance, short handoff, and agent instructions so a new session knows where to continue.

03

Keep the outcome

Retain tasks, errors, knowledge, scripts, Skills, and MCPs according to their real maintenance value.

Q+
MEMBERS / WHAT STAYS

A “member” is a managed object, not a subscription.

Projects, accounts, devices, reusable scripts, Skills, programs, and MCPs can each have an identity, owner, and handoff record when you maintain them over time. Internal files stay with their parent. Passwords and keys are represented only by references to secure storage.

Stable identityOrigin and ownerReal verificationNext step

When Qiming helps

Use it for work that continues over time: scattered material, changing agents or computers, and a need to resume from real progress. A software project, manuscript, website, or local AI setup can each start in one folder.

  • You need to recover the last verified state
  • You maintain projects, services, works, or tools
  • You want to separate completion from real verification

When to keep it simple

For a one-off answer, translation, or file lookup, just do the task. Qiming does not automatically control other folders and does not replace specialist tools, real acceptance, or your authorization for risky actions.

  • The task ends after one answer
  • You expect installation to control every device
  • You would treat records as backups or monitoring
